summary: AB Commercial Real Estate Private Debt Fund, LLC disclosed via Form 8-K that its wholly-owned subsidiary, AB CRE PDF Lending VI LLC, entered a $500 million uncommitted master repurchase agreement on September 14, 2026 with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, New York Branch. The facility finances eligible commercial mortgage loans collateralized by office, retail, industrial, hospitality, multi-family, or self-storage properties, with new-loan additions permitted until September 14, 2029 and the Company guaranteeing certain subsidiary obligations. This is an ordinary financing/credit-facility arrangement rather than a special situation; watch advance rates, market-value triggers, and potential margin-call dynamics given uncommitted capacity and warehouse-style leverage.
